description: Explain the element at a position: its kind, qualified name, type, value and documentation, as Markdown.

path.description: the document, absolute or relative to the workspace root; a sysml://stdlib/<file> URI for a standard library document

position.description: the position (1-based line and character column)

name: hover

markdown.description: the hover text, Markdown; empty when nothing is at the position

range.description: the span the hover applies to

end.description: character after the span (1-based line and column)

start.description: first character of the span (1-based line and column)
